head: Bathymetry Maps shows US coastal water depths for trip planning
dek: Bathymetry Maps, a new $1.99 iPhone app, pulls water depths from NOAA charts and Army Corps surveys for any area you draw on US coastal waters, with a 3D seafloor view. The maker says it's for planning only, not navigation; it was #18 in Navigation on the US paid chart on 17 November.
